name: Gorillos
summary:
Unleash your inner primate in Gorillos — a fast-paced multiplayer VR experience built for thrill-seekers and competitive climbers!
Swing, climb, and parkour through vibrant maps using only your arms and momentum. Compete in various game modes like Tag, Infection, and Custom Challenges with players around the world.
